Generally no — South Russell follows standard county rules for tree removal on private property. Large-scale clearing can trigger zoning review. Roubic confirms any permit requirement as part of every written estimate.

Every South Russell job is quoted on-site — we don't publish set pricing for this expansion market. Cost depends on tree size, condition, access, and whether crane-assist or haul-off is needed. The on-site estimate is always free, with confirmed pricing before you book.
What tree services do you offer in South Russell?
Tree removal is our core South Russell service line, including crane-assisted removals and storm-damage work. Other services are handled case-by-case for this expansion market — just call and ask.
Are you licensed and insured to work in South Russell?
Yes — Roubic carries general liability and workers-comp insurance. A certificate of insurance is available on request and included in the estimate packet when a job requires COI submission.
